diff_stats.justification_for_overage: This is a large feature delivery (M1-M29) that removes an architectural split (EDITOR_MODE) and adds 29 acceptance criteria worth of functionality: save state, offline/conflict detection, approve button, export buttons, mobile layout, candidates sidebar rewrite, bidirectional drag, tap-to-select, budget recompute, conn-status badge. Minimum estimate is 750 lines; 882 lines added vs 32 removed is justified by scope.

dev.qa_notes: Key test targets: (1) AC1: grep -c EDITOR_MODE scripts/lib/react_template.tpl should return 0. (2) AC24: Approve button disabled when accommodation slot missing from editorDay. (3) AC26: Export disabled when accommodation slot missing. (4) M10/AC11: Budget total updates after selection save (liveDayTotal displayed). (5) Stale save detection: rapid concurrent saves only update UI from the last response. (6) Offline: saves skipped when offline. (7) Conflict: ConflictBanner shown on 409 or 409-soft. (8) Mobile: CandidatesSidebar appears as tab at <768px. (9) Cross-meal drop: originSlotId passed to server for M20 server-side copy. Features NOT implemented: M11/AC12/AC23 (route gaps with retry), M15/AC15 (live cover image), M22/AC22 (slot visual states), M21 data-drop-reject.

fix_pass_3.triggered_by: dev cycle 3 — QA round 3 identified 5 micro-fix blockers: FIX A (missing mode field in fetchRoute), FIX B (wrong response field path), FIX C (option_id not stamped on board cards), FIX D (late_arrival_placeholder string heuristic), FIX E (skipped_reason literal string)
fixes_applied: FIX A (line 2411): Added mode: 'driving' to fetchRoute POST body JSON. route.py _try_cache_hit does req['mode'] with no default — missing field would KeyError 500. 'driving' maps to 'driving' in _MODE_TO_COMMAND.

FIX B (line 775): Changed data.duration_minutes to (data.segment && data.segment.duration_min). route.py _ok_response returns {status, segment, source} — duration is in segment.duration_min, never at top-level duration_minutes.

FIX C (lines 1919, 1950, 1964): After card.selected = true, also stamps card.option_id = selAccOpt.option_id (accommodation), card.option_id = selOpt.option_id (meal and activity arrays) in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay. KanbanView board drag payload reads opt.option_id — previously undefined for PLAN_DATA cards.

FIX D (line 1284): Replaced string heuristic (parseInt check_in hour >= 14) with if (edAcc && edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder) for late arrival badge. Uses actual backend boolean field instead of fragile string comparison.

FIX E (lines 898, 980, 1062, 1144, 1283): Changed static 'skipped' text to {edSlot.skipped_reason || 'skipped'} for activity/meal slots and {edAcc.skipped_reason || 'skipped'} for accommodation. Displays backend-provided reason string when present.
